Title: Java 11 support for Azure Functions is now generally available

Body.Content:
Java 11 support for Azure Functions is now generally available on Consumption and Premium plans for Windows and Linux. Develop and deploy Functions apps using Java 11 with the tools of your choice, such as Azure portal, Azure CLI, VSCode, Powershell cmdlet, Gradle, and Maven tools.

Learn more about Azure Functions with Java 11.
